extraModels.title: Extra models
extraModels.description: Model ids the Model card lists after Opus, Sonnet and Haiku, separated by commas or spaces: a pinned version, or the ids your LLM gateway serves (e.g. claude-opus-5-5, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5). Empty lists the three only.
